record.title: Three Pagodas selective Thai closure during fighting near Mon villages
record.region: East and Southeast Asia and Oceania
record.scope: Three Pagodas local frontier routes; Thai travellers and regular trade/vehicle passage restricted
record.crossings: Three Pagodas Pass; Soi Kaset 1; paths opposite Ban Bor Yeepun and Ban Rai Oi
record.direction: Thai outbound travellers and named trade/vehicle routes restricted; Myanmar worker entry remained possible.
record.movement: Thai travellers, regular border trade and vehicles on the named passage.
record.exceptions: Myanmar workers allowed through one channel; separate reporting documents civilians fleeing into Thailand during the fighting.
record.imposing_authority: Thai military, including Surasi Task Force
record.enforcement: Troops guarded and sealed specified routes; not an airtight border.
record.consequences: Local shops and tourist stalls closed; tourists advised to stay away.
record.relationship: Resolves the late-November conflict component of EA-L005 and R2-EA-L001. Distinct from February 2020 worker-access dispute R2-EA-001 and R2-EA-002.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; current status not inferred
record.official_rationale: Prevent incursions and facilitate security operations after nearby fighting.
record.context: Fighting between Myanmar forces, an allied Border Guard Force and Mon forces occurred on 27 November. A 29 November report describes restrictions still in place on the Thai side while preserving a worker entry channel.
record.uncertainty: Original closure report was retrieved as a substantive indexed archive extract. Exact onset and final reopening are not established. Fighting began on 27 November, but that date is not automatically assigned as closure onset. March 2020 reopening belongs to a different dispute.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty
